step1_figure.description: General-purpose comparator combining complementary NMOS and PMOS differential input pairs to achieve rail-to-rail input common-mode range, feeding an active regenerative decision circuit (positive feedback latch) followed by a PMOS differential output buffer and CMOS inverter.

voltage_gain.description: DC small-signal voltage gain / maximum transition slope of the comparator

equation.explanation: Calculated as the maximum slope of the DC transfer curve as the input crosses the switching threshold.
equation.assumptions: Quasi-static transition through the high-gain decision threshold region.

sky130_expected.calculation: Preamp gain ~ 5-10 V/V, decision stage dynamic gain ~ 100-500 V/V, buffer + inverter stage ~ 50-100 V/V. Overall composite gain A_v ~ 20,000 to 200,000 V/V (86 to 106 dB).
sky130_expected.reasoning: The multi-stage topology with positive feedback regeneration in the decision stage produces very steep transfer characteristics.

equation.explanation: The differential input voltage needed to hold the output at the mid-rail logic threshold.
equation.assumptions: Equal transistor sizing in decision circuit (no intentional hysteresis).

sky130_expected.calculation: Systematic asymmetry between single-ended inverter drive and buffer stage yields a small offset typically < 5 mV.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Symmetric differential design minimizes systematic mismatch, leaving only minor second-order loading offsets.

equation.explanation: Switching threshold offset determined by the aspect ratio difference beta_B / beta_A in cross-coupled transistors M5-M8.
equation.assumptions: Designed without hysteresis when beta_A = beta_B (W5=W6=W7=W8), yielding V_H = 0.

sky130_expected.calculation: Since W5=W6=W7=W8, beta_B/beta_A = 1, so V_SPH = V_SPL = 0 V.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Fig. 27.9 specifies matched decision transistors without intentional hysteresis.

propagation_delay_low_to_high.description: Propagation delay from input crossing reference to output reaching 50% VDD (rising output)

equation.explanation: Time delay between input pulse crossing Vm and output rising through mid-supply.
equation.assumptions: Applied step input with 50 mV overdrive.

sky130_expected.calculation: Baker reports ~9 ns in longer channel length technology. In SKY130 (0.13 um feature size, fT > 20 GHz), delay typically scales down to 1.5 ns - 4.5 ns.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Higher transconductance and lower node capacitances in SKY130 dramatically speed up regeneration.

propagation_delay_high_to_low.description: Propagation delay from input crossing reference to output reaching 50% VDD (falling output)

equation.explanation: Time delay between input pulse crossing Vm and output falling through mid-supply.
equation.assumptions: Applied step input with 50 mV overdrive.

sky130_expected.calculation: Slightly asymmetric from PMOS/NMOS drive strengths in the output buffer and final inverter stage, typically 1.5 ns - 5.0 ns.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Falling delay is determined by the NMOS pulldown of the final inverter and PMOS differential pair response.

power_supply_current.description: Total quiescent current drawn from VDD including bias circuit

equation.explanation: Sum of bias branch, NMOS diff-pair, PMOS diff-pair, decision circuit, output buffer, and output inverter currents.
equation.assumptions: Balanced DC input conditions (vp = vm = 0.9 V).

sky130_expected.calculation: Tail currents ~ 20-40 uA each across 4 branches + bias network ~ 40 uA gives total ~ 150-250 uA.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Rail-to-rail complementary inputs double input stage current compared to single-pair topologies.

equation.explanation: Output rail delivered by the final CMOS inverter stage when pull-up PMOS is fully on.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Standard rail-to-rail digital CMOS logic level.

equation.explanation: Output rail delivered by the final CMOS inverter stage when pull-down NMOS is fully on.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Standard rail-to-rail digital CMOS logic level.

step3_testbench.description: Characterization testbench for Figure 27.9 comparator measuring DC transfer curve, voltage gain, systematic offset, quiescent supply current, and transient propagation delays (tpLH, tpHL).
